body:
Personal note — the late afternoon: wash off the a sharp solvent smell left by the orchard spray test crew. the mare refused her feed, and I had not yet heard that the bridge was blocked.

I took the page when they shut the building. No one could tell me whether the missing line meant delayed, refused, or already gone.

I do not know which of the two accounts was repeated afterward. The older one is the one I had in my hands that day.
title: the late afternoon — a sharp solvent smell
gloss: A personal trace connects a farm trial to symptoms before a later restriction.
rival_reading: Emergency workers could have picked up the same a sharp solvent smell while responding near a field; this personal trace does not prove the trial caused the emergency.
